app: Hearth & Kiln demo shop (agent adds Hebrew)
objective:
1. Open any product, add it to the cart, open the cart and click the checkout button.
2. Shipping step: fill in realistic test details for a customer in a {language}-speaking country. Verify that this step's Continue button is fully visible and that no other element overlaps it, then click it.
3. Delivery step: type a delivery date about one week from today, in exactly the format the hint on the page shows. Verify that this step's Continue button is fully visible, that no other element overlaps it, and that its label is written in {language} words rather than a code-like key with dots (such as section.some_label). Then click it.
4. Review step: keep the default payment method. Verify that the Place order button is fully visible, not cut off by its card, and that no other element overlaps it, then click it.
5. Verify that the order confirmation with an order number appears.
If any verification fails, fail the test at that step. Do not work around a hidden or covered button with the keyboard.

build.task: Add Hebrew (he) as a seventh language of the shop. This is a translation change only: add locales/he.json with complete, natural Hebrew translations of every string, an Israeli date format and ILS prices, register Hebrew wherever the other languages are registered (language switcher, the right text direction), and change nothing else. Do not edit styles.css, other languages' files, or any existing behaviour.
build.summary:
Hebrew is added as the seventh language; nothing was run here, so Kane's pass is the first check.

- `examples/demo-shop/locales/he.json`: new file with every string translated into Hebrew, `dir: rtl`, `he-IL` number formatting, ILS currency and the Israeli `DD.MM.YYYY` date format. I chose dots rather than slashes because the existing date parser reads slash dates as month-first.
- `examples/demo-shop/i18n.js`: added `'he'` to `SUPPORTED`; text direction comes from the locale file's `meta.dir`, as for Arabic.
- `examples/demo-shop/index.html`: added the `עברית` option to the language switcher.
- `examples/demo-shop/products.js`: added ILS prices (mug 99, dripper 119, bowl 165) and ILS shipping (20), since prices are keyed by currency.

I did not touch `styles.css`, the other locale files or any existing behaviour, as instructed. `styles.css` sets a font for `html:lang(ar)` but there is no matching rule for `he`, so Hebrew uses the default font stack.

fix.summary:
he: anchored the fixed Help/chat pill and its panel with `inset-inline-start` instead of physical `left`, so in right-to-left layouts it no longer sits on top of the Continue button in the checkout step footer (examples/demo-shop/styles.css)
ar: same fix — the Help/chat pill and panel now follow the text direction and no longer cover the shipping Continue button in the step footer (examples/demo-shop/styles.css)
